description: This PHP class `CloudSearchDomainClient` is part of the AWS SDK and provides an interface to interact with Amazon CloudSearch Domains. It includes methods for searching, suggesting, and uploading documents, as well as internal methods to handle HTTP request conversions for specific use cases.

classes.name: CloudSearchDomainClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon CloudSearch Domain, supporting search, suggest, and document upload operations with custom HTTP request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client with configuration arguments and appends a custom handler for search requests.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Extends parent method to require an endpoint and auto-detect region from the endpoint URI.

methods.name: searchByPost
methods.description: Defines a handler that modifies search requests to use POST instead of GET for handling long query strings.

methods.name: convertGetToPost
methods.description: Converts a GET request into a POST request to avoid URL length restrictions.
